## {{< fa lightbulb >}} Other experiences

[25-29 Jan 2021]{.cv-date} **Course "The profession of the economic analyst"**\
Banca d'Italia, Bologna office (Italy)\
Analysis of regional and national economic data and creation of a brief results report, presented to the managers of the Bologna office; learning about the tasks and departments of Central Banks and the organisation of the European system.

[15-19 Jun 2020]{.cv-date} **Summer School 'Bio engineering: a week between genetics and electronics in a biomedical laboratory'**\
Opificio Golinelli (Bologna, Italy)\
During the summer school week, students build a fundamental tool for genetic analysis: the thermocycler. The device is assembled and programmed using Arduino, the well-known open source hardware/software platform that allows electronic prototypes to be made. Participants use it to perform a genetic test on some of their own DNA sequences. The results will then be compared with those obtained by similar commercial tools.
